task_description: Implement bulk upload for raw datasets per the approved design (revision 3): a synchronous atomic multipart :bulk endpoint that creates many immutable SourceFiles, and an asynchronous JSON-array dataset-import operation (202 + Idempotency-Key + status resource) backed by a durable Postgres worker job that validates completely before an all-or-nothing commit, bumps the workbench revision once, stales consumers, and reports typed per-entry issues.
